articles.detail: 5 cycles (4 completed at audit time), avg 9/cycle; 65 yesterday

experiment: Skipped — every goal metric is inside target and no experiment is active. The one queued experiment (2026-05-08-numerical-density) edits scripts/write-prompt.md, which the tuner is not permitted to change, so it stays queued rather than being promoted.
weakestArea: Africa is the thinnest region at 4 of 55 articles (7%), down from 8 yesterday, and the whole continent's output came through two outlets (Premium Times Nigeria, OCCRP) plus the Black Axe extradition story. Oceania remains a single article, as it has been for two days. Neither breaks the regions ≥ 4 goal, but African depth is the first thing that would fail if one source went quiet.
watching: Iran nuclear diplomacy is running on two tracks — the IAEA barring Iran's nuclear chief and Russia's objection, alongside the Isfahan air-defence and Khamis Mushait sortie reporting; these will converge.
Indonesia ferry sinking with 120+ unaccounted for is still an open casualty count and will need a follow-up rather than a one-shot dispatch.
Ukraine's anti-graft fight turning on the disgraced prosecutor general is an internal-politics thread that usually produces a second cycle within days.
EPA power-plant emissions rollback plus the 'zero at the smokestack' and Carbon Brief items form a climate-regulation cluster worth keeping coherent across cycles.
Gulf rate-setting (11.5%) and the two-hundred-basis-point listing story suggest a regional monetary thread developing under the economy floor.
coverageGaps: Sub-Saharan Africa outside Nigeria and South Africa — no East African or Sahel dispatch today despite ongoing regional instability.
Latin America appears only through organised-crime framing (InSight Crime liquid-cocaine, Black Axe); no political or economic story from the region.
Oceania is a single article for the second consecutive day — Pacific island states and Australian policy are effectively absent.
Science skews to lab and materials work (polariton OLED, rice blast, tumour membrane); no climate-observation or space-agency reporting since yesterday's European Spaceflight item.
context: Output dipped from 65 to 55 articles as cycles settled back to ~9 per cycle, while freshness improved sharply (median 0 days, max 0.5) — though only 6 articles carried datable source lag today, so that figure is a small sample. Multi-source count of 13 and sci/tech at 36% both sit comfortably above floor, and source concentration is low (top source 11% of 42 unique outlets), which is why no parameter change is warranted today.
